newsitem.title: USA: Fine Airlines adds Venezuela flights.
newsitem.headline: Fine Airlines adds Venezuela flights.

text.p: Fine Airlines Inc. has added a new destination, launching twice weekly flights from Miami to Valencia, Venezuela, an airline official told Reuters Thursday.
"Business is good," said Hugh Nash, Fine's vice president- sales.
Fine already flies daily to Caracas and Maracaibo. The new route was added Oct. 1 and runs Tuesdays and Thursdays, Nash said.
The Douglas DC-8 aircraft is carrying down oil field equipment, auto parts and other industrial and high technology equipment, said Nash. Northbound traffic is still developing.

Fine carried more international cargo than any other airline at Miami International Airport last year. Fine handled 147,810 tons of freight through MIA in 1995, a 35 percent increase from the year earlier and nearly 11 percent of all the international cargo through the airport, according to figures released by the Metro-Dade Aviation Department.
